summary.zh-Hans: 布鲁克林大桥于1883年落成，跨越东河，连接曼哈顿与布鲁克林。桥上设有供行人通行的步道。
summary.en: Completed in 1883, the Brooklyn Bridge spans the East River between Manhattan and Brooklyn. A pedestrian walkway allows visitors to cross on foot.

summary.zh-Hans: 弓桥是中央公园的一座铸铁桥，建于19世纪60年代初，横跨园中的湖，连接漫步区与贝塞斯达台地、樱桃山一带。
summary.en: Bow Bridge is a cast-iron bridge built in the early 1860s in Central Park. It crosses the Lake, connecting the Ramble with the Bethesda Terrace and Cherry Hill area.

summary.zh-Hans: 纽约的贝果可搭配奶油奶酪等抹酱。当地贝果店H&H说明，自家的面团先经水煮，再在门店烘烤。
summary.en: New York bagels can be served with cream cheese and other spreads. Local maker H&H describes kettle-boiling its dough before baking the bagels at its shops.

summary.zh-Hans: 披萨可以按片购买，是纽约街头能尝到的食物。格林威治村的Joe’s Pizza供应经典纽约切片披萨。
summary.en: Pizza sold by the slice is part of New York street food. Joe’s Pizza in Greenwich Village serves the classic New York slice.
